errors.text_span: 该图表显示了 11 个切片，每个切片代表一种不同的动词域。
errors.evidence: The figure contains two interconnected pie charts, not a single chart with 11 slices. The left chart has 9 slices and the right chart has 10 slices. The description fails to identify this fundamental structure.
The slice for “物态事态” (State of matter/affairs), which the machine calls “物质事态”, is light pink/mauve, not dark blue.
The category with 16.91% is “生产” (Production) and its color is green. “生活动” is not a category in the chart, and orange is not the correct color.
The slice for “社交” (Social) is light blue, not pink.
The slice for “身体动作” (Body movement) is light blue, not yellow. There are no yellow slices in the chart.

There is no category named “功能活动”. The two categories with a value of 10.64% are “心理活动” (Psychological activity) and “司法” (Judicial), which are mauve and dark teal/black, respectively. The green slice represents “生产” (Production) at 16.91%.
There is no category named “时尚” (Fashion). The category with 8.51% is “判断” (Judgment), and its color is teal, not brown.
The slice for “交通” (Traffic/Transportation) has a value of 4.26%, not 5.32%. Its color is light teal, not blue.
There is no category named “交易” (Transaction). The category with 18.09% is “方位改变” (Change of direction), and its color is dark orange, not purple.
There is no category named “事件” (Event). The category with 9.57% is “争斗” (Struggle), and its color is dark purple/maroon, not gray.
The “其他” (Other) slice is 19.38% and is medium blue. The description incorrectly assigns it the color red and the percentages of two other slices (“文教” and “生理活动”).

errors.text_span: 也没有称为图例或百分比标签
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there is no legend or percentage labels. A legend is clearly visible on the right side of the figure, and percentage labels are present within each slice of both pie charts.

errors.text_span: 有些切片，例如“交易”和“其他”切片，视觉上略微突出，提高了这些切片的可见度。
errors.evidence: The description claims that certain slices are 'visually slightly prominent'. This is incorrect; no slices are exploded or highlighted for emphasis. Furthermore, '交易' is not a category in the chart.

errors.text_span: 切片按照从左到右的顺序排列
errors.evidence: This phrase is nonsensical for describing the arrangement of slices in a pie chart, which are arranged radially.
